---
title: "The Interoception in Voice Scale (IVS)"
format: 
  html:
    include-in-header: 
      - text: <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js"></script>
---

<p id="ivs-instructions">Please read the sentences below and select your answer. There is no right or wrong.</p>

```{=html}
<div id="ivs-container">
<form id="ivs-form">
<div id="questions-container"></div>
<button type="submit" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; background-color: #0055ff; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 5px;">Submit</button>
</form>
</div>

<div id="score-display" style="display: none; margin-top: 20px; padding: 20px; background-color: #222; color: #fff; border-left: 5px solid #0055ff; border-radius: 5px;">
<h3 style="margin-bottom: 25px;">Your IVS Profile</h3>

<div style="margin-bottom: 30px;">
<div style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<strong>Emotional Voice Awareness (EA)</strong>
<div style="font-weight: bold; margin-top: 2px; color: #fff;">Score: <span id="score-ea"></span></div>
</div>
<div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #ccc; margin-bottom: 10px;">Awareness of emotional modulation in one’s voice</div>
<div style="width: 100%; background: #444; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden;">
<div id="bar-ea" style="height: 24px; background: #0055ff; width: 0%; transition: width 1.5s ease-in-out;"></div>
</div>
<div style="width: 100%; font-size: 0.75em; color: #888; margin-top: 4px; position: relative; height: 15px;">
<span style="position: absolute; left: 0;">0%</span>
<span style="position: absolute; right: 0;">100%</span>
</div>
</div>

<div style="margin-bottom: 30px;">
<div style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<strong>Physical Voice Awareness (PA)</strong>
<div style="font-weight: bold; margin-top: 2px; color: #fff;">Score: <span id="score-pa"></span></div>
</div>
<div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #ccc; margin-bottom: 10px;">Awareness of acoustic and physiological properties of the voice</div>
<div style="width: 100%; background: #444; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden;">
<div id="bar-pa" style="height: 24px; background: #0099ff; width: 0%; transition: width 1.5s ease-in-out;"></div>
</div>
<div style="width: 100%; font-size: 0.75em; color: #888; margin-top: 4px; position: relative; height: 15px;">
<span style="position: absolute; left: 0;">0%</span>
<span style="position: absolute; right: 0;">100%</span>
</div>
</div>

<div style="margin-bottom: 30px;">
<div style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<strong>Voice-related Concern (VC)</strong>
<div style="font-weight: bold; margin-top: 2px; color: #fff;">Score: <span id="score-vc"></span></div>
</div>
<div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #ccc; margin-bottom: 10px;">Tendency to experience worry or emotional reactions in response to vocal discomfort or throat sensations</div>
<div style="width: 100%; background: #444; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden;">
<div id="bar-vc" style="height: 24px; background: #00ccff; width: 0%; transition: width 1.5s ease-in-out;"></div>
</div>
<div style="width: 100%; font-size: 0.75em; color: #888; margin-top: 4px; position: relative; height: 15px;">
<span style="position: absolute; left: 0;">0%</span>
<span style="position: absolute; right: 0;">100%</span>
</div>
</div>

<div style="margin-bottom: 30px;">
<div style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<strong>Voice-related Attention (VA)</strong>
<div style="font-weight: bold; margin-top: 2px; color: #fff;">Score: <span id="score-va"></span></div>
</div>
<div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #ccc; margin-bottom: 10px;">Capacity to monitor voice-related cues such as posture, breathing, and vocal signals during communication</div>
<div style="width: 100%; background: #444; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden;">
<div id="bar-va" style="height: 24px; background: #00ffcc; width: 0%; transition: width 1.5s ease-in-out;"></div>
</div>
<div style="width: 100%; font-size: 0.75em; color: #888; margin-top: 4px; position: relative; height: 15px;">
<span style="position: absolute; left: 0;">0%</span>
<span style="position: absolute; right: 0;">100%</span>
</div>
</div>

<button id="download-btn" type="button" style="margin-top: 10px; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; background-color: #28a745; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 5px;">Download Results as Image</button>
</div>

<script>
const questions = [
  "I notice if my voice changes with different emotions",
  "I notice how my voice changes when I speak in different situations",
  "I can tell I am angry by the sound of my voice",
  "I can tell if I am happy by the sound of my voice",
  "I can tell I am stressed/anxious by the sound of my voice",
  "I notice when my voice sounds husky",
  "I notice when my voice sounds rough",
  "I notice when my voice sounds breathy",
  "I notice when my voice sounds weak",
  "I notice when my voice feels strained",
  "I get worried if I feel pain/discomfort in my throat",
  "When my voice feels uncomfortable, it dominates my attention",
  "I get upset when I feel pain/discomfort in my throat",
  "I worry about my throat when it feels uncomfortable",
  "I notice my posture when I am talking",
  "I listen for clues from my voice to let me know what emotion I am feeling",
  "I notice changes in my breathing over the day",
  "I can continue to pay attention to my voice even when there is a lot happening around",
  "I can pay attention to my voice even when my mind is racing"
];

const container = document.getElementById('questions-container');

questions.forEach((q, index) => {
  const qNum = index + 1;
  const html = `
<fieldset style="border: 1px solid #444; margin-bottom: 15px; padding: 15px; background: transparent; border-radius: 8px;">
<legend style="font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 1.0em;">${qNum}. ${q}</legend>
<label style="margin-right: 15px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.95em;"><input type="radio" name="q${qNum}" value="0" required> 0 (Never)</label>
<label style="margin-right: 15px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.95em;"><input type="radio" name="q${qNum}" value="1"> 1 (Occasionally)</label>
<label style="margin-right: 15px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.95em;"><input type="radio" name="q${qNum}" value="2"> 2 (Sometimes)</label>
<label style="margin-right: 15px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.95em;"><input type="radio" name="q${qNum}" value="3"> 3 (Often)</label>
<label style="margin-right: 15px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.95em;"><input type="radio" name="q${qNum}" value="4"> 4 (Always)</label>
</fieldset>
  `;
  container.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
});

document.getElementById('ivs-form').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();

  const dataPayload = {};
  for (let i = 1; i <= 19; i++) {
    dataPayload[`q${i}`] = parseInt(document.querySelector(`input[name="q${i}"]:checked`).value);
  }

  const ea = (dataPayload.q1 + dataPayload.q2 + dataPayload.q3 + dataPayload.q4 + dataPayload.q5) / 5;
  const pa = (dataPayload.q6 + dataPayload.q7 + dataPayload.q8 + dataPayload.q9 + dataPayload.q10) / 5;
  const vc = (dataPayload.q11 + dataPayload.q12 + dataPayload.q13 + dataPayload.q14) / 4;
  const va = (dataPayload.q15 + dataPayload.q16 + dataPayload.q17 + dataPayload.q18 + dataPayload.q19) / 5;

  dataPayload.ea = ea;
  dataPayload.pa = pa;
  dataPayload.vc = vc;
  dataPayload.va = va;

  document.getElementById('ivs-instructions').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('ivs-form').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('score-display').style.display = 'block';
  
  document.getElementById('score-ea').innerText = ea.toFixed(2) + " out of 4";
  document.getElementById('score-pa').innerText = pa.toFixed(2) + " out of 4";
  document.getElementById('score-vc').innerText = vc.toFixed(2) + " out of 4";
  document.getElementById('score-va').innerText = va.toFixed(2) + " out of 4";

  // Tiny delay to let the display: block render before animating the widths
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('bar-ea').style.width = (ea / 4 * 100) + "%";
    document.getElementById('bar-pa').style.width = (pa / 4 * 100) + "%";
    document.getElementById('bar-vc').style.width = (vc / 4 * 100) + "%";
    document.getElementById('bar-va').style.width = (va / 4 * 100) + "%";
  }, 50);

  const googleAppScriptURL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzNam3txAbgy73-c4SZTPgUfVnqbevmkTplErZ0XG68SGQBmo5wCASOZLJijkWYR5usDA/exec'; // <-- PASTE YOUR URL HERE

  fetch(googleAppScriptURL, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(dataPayload),
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' }
  }).then(response => {
    console.log("Data saved.");
  }).catch(error => console.error("Error:", error));
});

document.getElementById('download-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
  const btn = this;
  const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
  
  if (typeof html2canvas === 'undefined') {
    alert("Image generation requires a standard web browser. Please click 'Show in new window' to open this page in Chrome, Firefox, or Safari.");
    return;
  }

  btn.innerHTML = 'Generating Image...';
  btn.style.opacity = '0.7';
  btn.style.cursor = 'wait';

  // Temporarily strip the CSS transitions from the bars so html2canvas doesn't hang
  const bars = ['bar-ea', 'bar-pa', 'bar-vc', 'bar-va'];
  bars.forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).style.transition = 'none');

  // Add a tiny timeout to ensure the browser registers the transition removal
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      btn.style.display = 'none'; 
      
      html2canvas(document.getElementById('score-display'), {
        backgroundColor: '#222',
        scale: 2 
      }).then(canvas => {
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.download = 'IVS_Profile.png';
        link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
        link.click();
        
        // Restore button and transitions
        btn.style.display = 'inline-block';
        btn.innerHTML = originalText;
        btn.style.opacity = '1';
        btn.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        bars.forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).style.transition = 'width 1.5s ease-in-out');
        
      }).catch(err => {
        console.error("Canvas generation error:", err);
        // Restore button and transitions
        btn.style.display = 'inline-block';
        btn.innerHTML = originalText;
        btn.style.opacity = '1';
        btn.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        bars.forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).style.transition = 'width 1.5s ease-in-out');
        alert("There was an issue generating the image. Please try again.");
      });
    } catch(err) {
      console.error("Execution error:", err);
      // Restore button and transitions
      btn.style.display = 'inline-block';
      btn.innerHTML = originalText;
      btn.style.opacity = '1';
      btn.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      bars.forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).style.transition = 'width 1.5s ease-in-out');
      alert("An unexpected error occurred.");
    }
  }, 50);
});
</script>
